data.explanation: This is a private invoice, not from an authority, so there is no objection right. Pay the €1,400.00 by the deadline shown, which the app calculates from the invoice date. If you cannot pay in full, the shop says instalment payment (Ratenzahlung) can be arranged by contacting them directly. Keep the invoice for your tax return, as medical costs like this may count as extraordinary expenses (außergewöhnliche Belastungen).
